claims.text: Shireen Abu Akleh, Palestinian American Al Jazeera journalist, killed in May 2022 near Jenin; IDF: 'high possibility' a soldier fired, believing he shot at a terrorist; no criminal investigation; US forensic test inconclusive but State Department said Israel likely responsible; family: Israel trying to 'avoid responsibility'.

CPJ (9 Oct 2026): 118 arrests of journalists and a media worker since Oct 2023 (112 by Israel, 6 by PA); 39 still held; one journalist and one media worker died in Israeli custody; 31 Palestinian journalists held by Israel on 1 Dec 2025, most in administrative detention; 58 released journalists described torture or abuse; IDF: 'does not arrest journalists simply for being journalists'.

22 Sep 2024 masked Israeli soldiers raided Al Jazeera's Ramallah office live on air and ordered a 45-day closure; order accused it of 'incitement to and support of terrorism' (al-Omari); cameras confiscated.
